title: MedPAO-Assist: Edge-Deployable, Modality-Aware Agentic AI for Radiology Report Structuring
abstract: arXiv:2610.26913v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. To address this, we present MedPAO-Assist, an edge-deployable agentic framework that generates structured radiology reports directly from radiologist dictation and voice commands, requiring only $\approx3.3$ GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of $\approx31$ seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline. The system currently supports four major imaging modalities -- Chest X-ray, Chest CT, Abdomen CT, and Brain MRI. To our knowledge, it is among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter

translated_title: MedPAO-Assist：可边缘部署、模态感知的放射学报告结构化智能体AI
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型用于放射学报告结构化的应用，目前主要由专有云端模型或需要高端GPU部署的大型开源模型所主导，这对于要求数据隐私和离线运行的放射学工作流程的临床应用来说是一个关键瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MedPAO-Assist，这是一个可边缘部署的智能体框架，能够直接从放射科医生的口述和语音命令生成结构化的放射学报告，仅需约3.3 GB的峰值内存，并通过异步多线程执行流水线在标准笔记本电脑CPU上实现了约31秒的平均端到端延迟。该系统目前支持四种主要成像模态——胸部X光、胸部CT、腹部CT和脑部MRI。据我们所知，它是最早使用0.6B参数小语言模型（SLM）运行整个流水线的智能体系统之一。
tldr: MedPAO-Assist是一个可边缘部署的智能体框架，仅用0.6B参数的小语言模型，在普通笔记本CPU上（峰值内存约3.3GB、端到端延迟约31秒）即可将放射科医生的口述语音直接转化为结构化报告，满足数据隐私和离线运行的临床需求。
en_tdlr: MedPAO-Assist is an edge-deployable agentic framework that leverages a 0.6B-parameter small language model to convert radiologist dictation into structured radiology reports on a standard laptop CPU (only ~3.3 GB peak RAM and ~31s latency), enabling data privacy and offline operation.
